analysis.overall: You had a solid day with 88% time in range, enjoying a flat overnight baseline despite a couple of temporary rises over 200 mg/dL in the evening and around midday.

events.title: Evening bump around site change
events.description: Glucose crested at 212 mg/dL right after an evening site change, but stacked corrections brought you back into target before midnight.

events.title: Steady overnight baseline
events.description: Your readings settled smoothly between 73–85 mg/dL for most of the night without dipping into low territory.

events.title: Early morning spike
events.description: A brief morning rise pushed readings to 167 mg/dL, which came down quickly back to target following prompt corrections.

events.title: Delayed breakfast rise
events.description: Despite bolusing 5.2u for 60g carbs at 9:00 AM, glucose stayed flat early on before slowly climbing to 213 mg/dL several hours later.

events.title: Lunch bolus brings down high
events.description: A 4u bolus at 1:09 PM effectively turned around the high, bringing readings down from 204 mg/dL to 97 mg/dL by mid-afternoon.

analysis.watch_for_tomorrow: Notice how breakfast carbs took nearly an hour to start rising, which led to a delayed peak around lunchtime.
